purpose: Route-to-owner inventory and public contract for the canonical Actae instance API. One implementation owner per operation (RUST-001). CI enforces manifest <-> route parity and rejects duplicate resource implementations (RUST-002).

durability_model.event_store: PostgreSQL (agent_events table, per-channel cursor + internal global_cursor)
durability_model.fork_model: Fork is storage, not execution (D-009). POST /api/v1/channels/fork returns an exact child_channel_id + immutable ForkReceipt; it never starts an LLM process.
durability_model.ordering: Per-channel cursor is ordered; internal global_cursor provides a stable cross-channel order for keyset pagination. No cross-instance causal total order is promised (D-010).

websocket.protocol: type-tagged JSON frames; auth handshake then subscribe; per-channel cursor replay on subscribe; server does not echo broadcasts to the publishing connection (D-010).

client_messages.summary: Authenticate the connection with a session JWT (token) or API key (api_key). Required before subscribe/publish unless anonymous is enabled.
Subscribe to a channel, optionally from a per-channel cursor for resume.
Versioned multi-channel subscription (additive). Accepts a list of {topic, cursor} entries; equivalent to issuing multiple subscribe messages.
Publish a live event to a channel. Idempotent with operation_id.
Direct message to a specific connection (legacy).
Keepalive; server replies with a pong.

server_messages.summary: Latest cursor for a topic after subscribe

compat_rules.breaking_change_policy: Additive actae.api.v1 schemas only (D-011). Removal or type narrowing requires a new API version and a published deprecation period recorded in docs/API_DEPRECATIONS.md.
compat_rules.field_reuse: Do not rename existing event/state/channel fields. Only additive fields are allowed in actae.api.v1.
compat_rules.new_route_policy: Any new public route must be registered here with a unique operation id, owner, scope, and schema before merging (RUST-001). CI fails on unregistered routes.
compat_rules.duplicate_resource_policy: Events/state/channels/forks may only be implemented in the registered canonical handler/domain owner modules (RUST-002). Any parallel implementation requires an approved ADR in docs/adr/.
compat_rules.idempotency_policy: Fleet mutations require Idempotency-Key. Direct API mutations use native operation_id/execution_key where semantics support it.
compat_rules.destructive_policy: Destructive fleet operations require X-Actae-Confirm-Target equal to the canonical target resource id; wildcards and mismatches are rejected.
compat_rules.gateway_policy: The fleet gateway routes typed, versioned canonical operations only. It must not forward arbitrary customer-controlled paths, headers, or methods (D-005). No second event store, state engine, migrations, or authorization system (RUST-007).
